purpose: Lower-cost standalone LTE voice and SMS options for a US prototype; quotes exclude tax, tariffs, shipping, antenna, SIM, service, PCB, power and audio integration.

best_confirmed_option.type: LTE Cat 1 surface-mount module (not a bare modem IC)
best_confirmed_option.manufacturer_voice_evidence: SIMCom lists VoLTE in A7672G family Product Advantages and analog audio in the A7672G column; exact firmware/carrier service is not proven.
best_confirmed_option.manufacturer_us_bands: LTE-FDD B2/B4/B5/B12/B13/B25/B26/B66, among others; B71 not listed for A7672G.
best_confirmed_option.sms_evidence: A76XX series supports AT-command SMS; verify firmware and carrier provisioning in an end-to-end test.
best_confirmed_option.price_q30_tier: DigiKey cut-tape 25+ tier; 30 units at that tier
best_confirmed_option.stock: 0 currently at DigiKey; quote is a planning price, not an immediately orderable 30-unit lot

cheaper_unqualified_leads.stock: 1 at LCSC when checked; 30-unit tier is only indicative
cheaper_unqualified_leads.qualification: Do not budget as a proven US VoLTE voice solution: the exact A7670G-LABE manufacturer sheet retrieved did not explicitly document VoLTE. GSM voice fallback is not an acceptable US design assumption.

cheaper_unqualified_leads.stock: 4 at LCSC when checked; 30-unit tier is only indicative
cheaper_unqualified_leads.qualification: Rejected for direct US calls: SIMCom explicitly lists VoLTE = NA for SIM7670G. It can be an LTE data candidate, not the requested carrier voice path.

caveats: VoLTE feature and US LTE bands do not prove operation with a particular SIM or US carrier; firmware, IMS provisioning, device acceptance and plan must be validated.
LTE Cat 1 module size is 24 x 24 x 2.4 mm; antenna, RF clearance, supply current and audio connections make fit in a small pendant unproven.
Phone-mediated calls/SMS over Bluetooth require no additional cellular module in the pendant and are a distinct architecture from standalone cellular.
Do not use US 2G fallback as the basis for call capability.
